chars.N: NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black joggers and white sneakers.
chars.Y: YASSER: a young Moroccan office employee wearing a light-blue dress shirt with a dark red tie, grey trousers, and a blue ID badge on a lanyard.
chars.F: FOUAD: a young Moroccan man wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and beige chinos.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a busy Rabat street cafe with mint tea glasses on a small table: YASSER leans across the table toward NARRATOR, gripping his arm urgently with a tense worried face, while NARRATOR leans back with a sly guilty half-smile. Two people facing each other in open tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Rabat cafe table: YASSER slams a thick stack of Moroccan banknotes on the table between them; NARRATOR's eyes go wide, jaw dropped, hands frozen in shock.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe: NARRATOR stares at YASSER suspiciously, finger on his chin, while YASSER pats his empty trouser pockets with an awkward shy smile, the money still on the table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe: YASSER explains with his hands, splitting the money stack into two halves with a serious face; NARRATOR leans in listening, greedy grin growing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Small daydream panel inside a Rabat apartment living room: FOUAD proudly shows YASSER a small envelope of cash, smiling; YASSER watches with envy, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Back at the Rabat cafe: YASSER puts a finger to his lips in a 'shh, keep it secret' gesture, glancing over his shoulder nervously; NARRATOR raises his eyebrows, confused and suspicious.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A modest Moroccan bedroom: NARRATOR jumps happily on his bed throwing banknotes into the air like rain, huge silly grin, money flying around him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, the same bedroom: NARRATOR hurriedly stuffs the stacks of banknotes into a backpack, a travel bag open on the bed, looking toward the door with a sneaky determined face, ready to run away.
